title: Ignition probability record (contract v0.1.0)
description: One record per grid cell per local day. The API returns an array of these records. Probability is the model's estimated chance of at least one ignition in that 10 km cell on that local America/Toronto day; it is not a precision. See grid_spec.md.

cell_id.description: ofr10km_{x0}_{y0}, EPSG:3978 SW corner in metres

date.description: Local America/Toronto calendar date the probability applies to

probability.description: P(>=1 ignition in cell on date). Base rate in the 2019 test is about 0.000286, so values are small

model_version.description: Model identifier and version, e.g. a model family plus feature/cache version

data_timestamp.description: UTC time of the newest input observation or forecast used for this record

stale_flag.description: True when any input is older than the thresholds in cache_fallback.md and cached data was used

disclaimer.const: Research estimate for decision support only. It does not replace official fire alerts, warnings or evacuation orders.

stale_reason.description: Optional human-readable reason when stale_flag is true

rank_in_day.description: Optional rank of this cell among all cells on the date (1 = highest probability); supports top-k reporting

grid_version.description: Optional grid version from grid_spec.md, e.g. ofr10km-v1

generated_at.description: Optional UTC time this record was produced
